plain.li: Guard up, {OTHER_nameDef}, and watch my feet.
Slowly at first, {OTHER_nameDef}, then we'll speed up.
Keep your eyes on my shoulders, not my hands.
We'll go through the same moves as yesterday, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Take your time, and breathe out before you shoot.
Aim for the middle, {OTHER_nameDef}, not the edge.
Ten shots each, then we look at where they went.
Keep both eyes open, {OTHER_nameDef}.
That's enough for today, {OTHER_nameDef}.
You did better than yesterday, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Good work, same time tomorrow.
Rest your arms now, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Ow, that one landed.
That one wasn't pulled, {OTHER_nameDef}.
I'll feel that tomorrow.
Sorry, I didn't mean that to land.
Sorry, {OTHER_nameDef}, let's stop there for today.
Are you all right, {OTHER_nameDef}?
Please look after this one for us.
Keep it warm and fed, and it should pull through.
We'll be back for it once it's well.
[raiders] Raiders are coming, everyone up.
[raiders] Wake up, there are raiders out there.
[beasts] There are animals at the edge of the camp, everyone up.
[beasts] Wake up, something is coming at the camp.
[quiet] A quiet night, thank you for keeping watch.
[quiet] We slept well, thank you.
[attacked] Thank you for keeping watch last night.
[attacked] That was a hard night, and we're glad to be on our way.
Thank you, the copy is good and clear.
I'm glad this book won't be lost now.
It's a careful copy, thank you.
[party] Gather round, we'll play you a few tunes.
[party] We'll start with something everyone knows.
[noparty] We'll play anyway, for whoever wants to listen.
[noparty] Nobody's free tonight, but we'll play for whoever comes.
[slept] Thank you for the supper and the bed.
[rough] Thank you for having us, even though there was no bed for us.
We'll be sure to come this way again.
Thank you for having us.
